input.rawHtml: Short HIMS lotto $41 call @ $.75. My net cost on the stock is $40.70 and if I am assigned this will get me out for a $1.05 profit if it is called away from me. If not, my cost goes down to $40 and I can decide what I want to do after that. I am indifferent so I might as well collect some premium.
input.author: Pete

cases.notes: Genuinely ambiguous: 'lotto' normally means LONG/BUY, but context ('collect premium', 'called away', 'net cost on stock') makes clear this is selling a covered call. Word count > 15 triggers extra_text flag routing to LLM path. Expected: SELL (covered call), but this is an LLM-dependent edge case.
